name: Ringo
prompt:
Generate a FRESH replacement character reference sheet of RINGO STARR from the 1965 Beatles TV cartoon. Use image1, the FIVE-ANGLE RINGO HEAD STRIP, as the PRIMARY character model. It gives left profile, left three-quarter, front, right three-quarter, right profile. Original episode frames2-4 and model-sheet5 corroborate the design. In frame4 Ringo is the LEFT figure, ignore the man on the right.
Create a clean high-resolution transparent landscape image, 4 columns x 3 rows, twelve separated complete full-body Ringo drawings, black boots and all hair fully visible. Use a shorter, slightly hunched long-armed body, blue long blazer and trousers, navy TURTLENECK without tie. Huge pear nose and tiny chin, sleepy eyes, shaggy flared black nape.
Row1 exactly:
COL1 directly front, head like portrait3 of image1.
COL2 head and body at a GENTLE THREE-QUARTER 35-45-degree angle toward screen-right. Copy head portrait4 of image1. SHOW TWO COMPLETE EYES AND TWO BROWS CLEARLY. Put nose between the two eyes, far eye visibly 60-75 percent as wide as near eye. Both cheeks visible, broad front face area, pear nose diagonally across face. This MUST BE visibly different from a pure side view. Use gentler yaw if necessary to keep both eyes obvious. This pose must NOT have a single-eye silhouette.
COL3 strict 90-degree pure PROFILE facing screen-right, head like portrait5 image1. ONLY ONE EYE visible, face a thin side silhouette with huge nose protruding beyond forehead and lips.
COL4 rear view.
Row2: waving (two-eye three-quarter face); running LEFT (single-eye left profile); running RIGHT (single-eye right profile); airborne jump (two-eye three-quarter).
Row3: thoughtful waiting hand at chin (two eyes); disappointed drooping (two eyes); cheering both arms raised (two eyes); playing small snare drum with neck strap and two sticks (two-eye three-quarter).
CRITICAL READABILITY: front and three-quarter are TWO-EYE faces; left/right pure profiles are ONE-EYE faces. Maintain clearly distinct giant pear nose, tiny chin and Ringo hair. Do not turn Ringo into another Beatle. Keep the same head-to-body ratio across poses and generous empty spacing. Simple crisp 1960s black ink outlines, flat blue/peach/black colors. No gradients, shading, environment, captions, text, grid lines, giant props, spectacles, moustache, beard or Yellow Submarine design. True transparent background. This is supplemental AI artwork, not archival footage.
